method: Published diagnostic index. The local audit retains the original traces and response text. Join by scenario and turn.

R01.cause: Context rewrite can change the current relation, subject or requested detail instead of replacing only the referent.
R01.measure: Assert explicit current relation, subject, time and requested output survive contextual resolution.

R02.cause: Typed selections and short references do not always preserve a pending task, earlier entity or explicit topic correction. Exact mechanism varies by case.
R02.measure: Test explicit corrections, ambiguous pairs, prior-topic return, policy scope and Arabic-English references with the same CID.

R03.cause: Lexical route/intent precedence or broad golden/meta matches select the wrong capability despite service health.
R03.measure: Record route candidates, override reason and result. Assert course recommendation does not become program ranking.

R04.cause: Retrieval or fusion returns evidence for a neighboring topic or the wrong evidence channel. Candidate-level details are incomplete for most turns.
R04.measure: Separate route error, no relevant candidate, filter rejection and misplaced final facts. Preserve source applicability.

R05.cause: Visible source IDs and a conversational explanation of what supports the current or previous claim are inconsistent across return paths.
R05.measure: Require direct and hybrid outputs to preserve attribution and useful missing-evidence statements. Do not demand fake citations.

R06.cause: Repeated templates and conversation-meta routing substitute reciting, a generic refusal or an irrelevant prompt for a requested explanation or rephrase.
R06.measure: Evaluate continuation, concise rephrasing, context-specific clarification and repeated framing with blinded human rubric.

R07.cause: Specific graph waits or empty retrieval can approach the client deadline or degrade to general passages. A long request alone does not prove unavailability.
R07.measure: Capture stage latency, timeout versus empty result, effective configured deadlines and cancellation. Test isolated service degradation.

R09.cause: Supported decomposition rules miss a multi-entity intent or only one part retrieves usable evidence. Different subtypes may have different causes.
R09.measure: Retain one subject/relation/week bundle per sub-intent with per-part evidence, coverage and explicit missing parts.
